won_reason: Structured pilot with defined success criteria converted cleanly — VP Finance signed off based on pilot results

calls.notes: Tanvi has a workflow automation need — approvals taking 5+ days causing revenue delays. She wants a pilot before committing. We agreed immediately but structured it: 30-day pilot, 3 specific success metrics agreed upfront: approval time under 24 hours, zero escalations to management, 90% team adoption. Marcus Lee introduced himself briefly and said if numbers prove it, he will sign.

Pilot Day 15 check-in. Approval time already at 26 hours — close to target. Team adoption at 85%. One issue with Slack integration — fixed it within 4 hours. Tanvi is very happy. We documented everything with screenshots for Marcus.

Pilot completed. Results: approval time at 18 hours (target was 24), zero escalations, 94% adoption (target was 90%). We sent Marcus a formal pilot results report with before/after metrics. Asked for a decision call next week.

Marcus mentioned Monday.com was also evaluated. We sent a direct comparison on the 3 pilot metrics — Monday.com had not run a structured pilot so had no comparable data. Marcus appreciated the data-driven approach.

WON. Marcus signed annual contract. He said the pilot report made it easy — he could defend the decision to the board with hard data. Tanvi said the quick bug fix during pilot showed we are a reliable partner.

lessons_learned: Agree to pilot only with defined success criteria — never open-ended trials
Document pilot results formally and share with decision maker, not just champion
Quick responsiveness during pilot builds trust more than any sales pitch
Pilot results beat competitor claims — data from live use is the strongest proof
30-day structured pilot is better than 90-day open trial every time
